2026 Cook Islands general election.lead: General elections were held in the Cook Islands on 12 August 2026 to determine the composition of the 19th Parliament.

2026 Zambian general election.lead: General elections were held in Zambia on 13 August 2026 to elect a president, members of the National Assembly, councillors and council chairs.

2026 Kazakh legislative election.lead: Legislative elections were held in Kazakhstan on 23 August 2026 to elect all 145 members of the Kurultai of the 1st convocation. It was the 10th legislative election since Kazakhstan's independence in 1991 and the first election to the country's new unicameral legislature established by the 2026 Constitution. Turnout was 74.2%, making it the highest turnout recorded in a national vote in Kazakhstan since the 2026 referendum and the highest turnout in a legislative election since 2016.

2026 Icelandic European Union membership.lead: A referendum on the resumption of European Union membership negotiations by the Icelandic government was held in Iceland on 29 August 2026. Its result was to reject the proposal for resuming accession negotiations with 52.84% voting no and 47.16% voting yes.

2026 Guinea-Bissau constitutional refere.lead: A constitutional referendum on expanding presidential powers was held on 30 August 2026 by the ruling military junta in Guinea-Bissau. The proposal was accepted with a majority of 70%.

2026 Swedish general election.lead: General elections were held in Sweden on 13 September 2026 to elect the 349 members of the Riksdag, alongside municipal and regional elections. The incumbent Ulf Kristersson cabinet was a coalition minority between the Moderate Party (M), the Christian Democrats (KD), and the Liberals (L), with external support from the Sweden Democrats (SD) under the Tidö Agreement. It was the first general election since Sweden joined NATO in 2024 and resulted in the left-leaning opposition winning a narrow parliamentary majority.

2026 Russian legislative election.lead: Legislative elections were held in Russia from 18 to 20 September 2026, to elect all 450 seats of the 9th State Duma, the lower house of the Federal Assembly. Going into the election, United Russia was the incumbent and largest party with 310 seats.

2026 Moroccan general election.lead: General elections were held in Morocco on 23 September 2026 to elect all 395 members of the House of Representatives. The election was the 12th legislative election held in Morocco since independence in 1956. Voting took place under direct universal suffrage using a party-list proportional representation system.

2026 Manx general election.lead: A general election was held on the Isle of Man on 24 September 2026.

2026 São Toméan parliamentary election.lead: Parliamentary elections were held in São Tomé and Príncipe on 27 September 2026. No party won an outright majority, with the MLSTP – Social Democratic Party winning a plurality of 24 seats out of 55 in the National Assembly.

2026 Swiss referendums.lead: Several referendums were held in Switzerland during 2026, with national votes on 8 March, 14 June, 27 September and one planned for 29 November.

2026 Latvian parliamentary election.lead: Parliamentary elections were held in Latvia on 3 October 2026, following the end of the term of the fourteenth Saeima elected in 2022.

2026 Bosnian general election.lead: General elections were held in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 4 October 2026. They decided the makeup of the presidency as well as national, entity and cantonal governments. Voter turnout was 42.98% for the presidential election, and 44.26% for the parliamentary election, the lowest ever voter turnout for a general election in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

2026 Brazilian general election.lead: General elections were held in Brazil on 4 October 2026 to elect the president, vice president, members of the National Congress, the governors, vice governors and legislative assemblies of all federative units, and the district council of Fernando de Noronha. As no candidate for president received more than half of the valid votes in the first round, a runoff election was held on 25 October.

2026 Czech Senate election.lead: The first round of the election to the Senate, the upper house of the Parliament of the Czech Republic, were held on 9 and 10 October 2026, along with the 2026 municipal elections. In districts where second round run-off was necessary, voters elected a Senator by a simple majority on 16 and 17 October.

2026 Bulgarian presidential election.lead: Presidential elections were held in Bulgaria on 25 October 2026. Incumbent president Iliana Iotova was eligible and ran for a full term.

2026 Serbian parliamentary election.lead: Early parliamentary elections were held in Serbia on 25 October 2026 to elect members of the National Assembly. The elections were originally due by December 2027; Aleksandar Vučić, then the president of Serbia, dissolved the National Assembly and called the elections on 9 September 2026, on the proposal of the government. The Student List won the election with an absolute majority of seats, defeating the Serbian Progressive Party (SNS), which had been in power since 2012. According to the preliminary results adopted by the Republic Electoral Commission (RIK) on 26 October, the Student List won 52.7% of the votes cast and 140 of the 250 seats, while the SNS-led "Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia" list won 39.2% and 104 seats; apart from national minority lists which are exempt from it, no other list crossed the electoral threshold. On 28 October, after the votes cast abroad had been processed, RIK member Ivan Šebek said that the Student List had gained a seat, for a total of 141, while United Serbia had dropped to 103. The final CeSID–Ipsos projection, which excluded polling stations abroad, gave the Student List 141 seats and United Serbia 103. Turnout was around 69%, about ten percentage points higher than in 2023. Vučić conceded defeat on election night.

2026 Israeli legislative election.lead: Legislative elections were held in Israel on 27 October 2026 to elect the 120 members of the 26th Knesset and determine the governing coalition that succeeds the 37th government led by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

2026 United States House of Representati.lead: The 2026 United States House of Representatives elections are scheduled to be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, as part of the 2026 midterm elections during President Donald Trump's second nonconsecutive term. Voters will elect representatives from all 435 congressional districts across each of the fifty U.S. states, and five of the six non-voting delegates from the District of Columbia and the inhabited U.S. territories.
2026 United States House of Representati.previous: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections

2026 Grenadian general election.lead: General elections are scheduled to be held in Grenada on 5 November 2026.

2026 New Zealand general election.lead: The 2026 New Zealand general election is scheduled to be held on 7 November 2026. Voters will elect 120 members to the House of Representatives under New Zealand's mixed-member proportional (MMP) voting system, comprising 71 members elected from single-member electorates and 49 members elected from closed party lists to achieve proportionality.

2026 Cape Verdean presidential election.lead: Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in Cape Verde on 15 November 2026.

2026 Spanish general election.lead: A general election will be held in Spain on 29 November 2026 to elect the members of the 16th Cortes Generales under the Spanish Constitution of 1978. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies will be up for election, as well as 209 of 267 seats in the Senate.

2026 Gambian presidential election.lead: Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in the Gambia on 5 December 2026. Incumbent president Adama Barrow is running for a third term.

2026 Fijian constitutional referendum.lead: A constitutional referendum has been provisionally scheduled to be held in Fiji on 9 December 2026 to determine whether to approve the draft of a new Constitution. While Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka has announced the referendum date, it cannot take place unless parliament approves the third reading of the constitutional amendment bill.

2026 South Sudanese general election.lead: General elections are due to be held in South Sudan on 22 December 2026, the first since independence.

2027 Nigerian general election.lead: General elections will be held in Nigeria on 16 January 2027 to elect the president and vice president, members of the Senate and House of Representatives. Elections to elect state governors, and members of the house of assembly will be held on 6 February 2027. The Incumbent president Bola Tinubu has made known his intention to run for a 2nd term under the All Progressives Congress. The election will be in alignment with the Electoral Act 2026. Ban has been lifted on the campaign since Wednesday, August 19, 2026 ahead of the election and different political parties have started their campaigns already.

2027 Kyrgyz presidential election.lead: Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in Kyrgyzstan on 27 January 2027. Incumbent president Sadyr Japarov has announced that he will seek a second term in office. The election follows a constitutional ruling in February 2026 that determined that Japarov's current six-year mandate, which began in 2021, would count as his first presidential term, allowing him to seek re-election under the 2021 Constitution.

2027 Salvadoran presidential election.lead: Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in El Salvador on 28 February 2027, three years after the 2024 presidential election. They will occur with concurrent legislative and municipal elections. In July 2025, the Legislative Assembly of El Salvador voted to move the date of the next presidential election from 2029 to 2027. It also approved several constitutional amendments, among them, the abolition of presidential term limits and the increase of presidential term lengths from five to six years.

2027 Micronesian general election.lead: General elections are scheduled to be held in the Federated States of Micronesia on 2 March 2027.

2027 Gambian parliamentary election.lead: Parliamentary elections are scheduled to be held in The Gambia on 10 April 2027.

2027 French presidential election.lead: Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in France on 18 April 2027, with a second round on 2 May if no candidate secures a majority vote. The election may be held earlier under exceptional circumstances if the presidency falls vacant before then.

2027 Finnish parliamentary election.lead: Parliamentary elections will be held in Finland on 18 April 2027 to elect members of parliament for the 2027–2031 term. It will be the first parliamentary election in Finland since the country acceded to NATO on 4 April 2023, ending 75 years of military non-alignment for the country.

2027 Burundian presidential election.lead: Presidential elections are expected to be held in Burundi in 2027.

2027 Mexican legislative election.lead: Legislative elections are scheduled to be held in Mexico on 6 June 2027. Voters will elect all 500 members of the Chamber of Deputies, who will serve during the LXVII Legislature (2027–2030). These elections will take place concurrently with the 2027 state elections.

2027 Guatemalan general election.lead: General elections will be held in Guatemala in June 2027 to elect the president and vice president, all 160 seats in Congress, all 20 Guatemalan members of the Central American Parliament, and mayors and councils for all the country's 340 municipalities, with a second round of the presidential elections to be held in August if no candidate wins a majority in the first round. Incumbent President Bernardo Arévalo is constitutionally prohibited from running for a second four-year term.

2027 Kenyan general election.lead: The 2027 Kenyan general election is scheduled to be held on 10 August 2027 to elect the President, members of the National Assembly, senators, county governors, women representatives and members of county assemblies. It will be the fourth general election held under the 2010 Constitution of Kenya. Incumbent President William Ruto will seek re-election for a second term.

2027 Angolan general election.lead: General elections are scheduled to be held in Angola by August 2027.

Next Slovak parliamentary election.lead: Parliamentary elections are scheduled to be held in Slovakia by 28 September 2027 to elect members of the National Council, although they can be held sooner if a snap election is called.

2026 Slovenian referendum.lead:
A four-question non-binding referendum was held in Slovenia on 11 October 2026. The questions were:Overturning the Law on Parliamentary Investigation that was adopted by the National Assembly in May 2026
Making social assistance conditional on carrying out of community service
Limiting voting rights in local elections to Slovenian and EU citizens
Abolition of the RTV SLO licence fee

2026 Serbian presidential election.lead: Presidential elections will be held in Serbia by 26 December 2026 to elect the president of Serbia, following the resignation of Aleksandar Vučić to run for prime minister in the 2026 parliamentary election. Vučić is ineligible to run again as president, as he has served two consecutive terms.

2027 Argentine general election.lead: General elections are scheduled to take place in Argentina on 24 October 2027. Voters will elect the president and vice president of Argentina, members in the Chamber of Deputies and Senate, and the governors of most provinces. Incumbent president Javier Milei is running for re-election for a second term.
